//: Root package.json - only used to start backend and frontend together.
First time: run 'npm install' here AND in src/public/frontend.
Then run 'npm run dev' from the project root to start both:
- backend:  Spring Boot on http://localhost:8080 (also starts the Postgres container via Docker)
- frontend: Vite/React on http://localhost:5173 (/api calls are proxied to the backend)
Ctrl+C stops both. Mac/Linux: change 'mvnw' to './mvnw' in dev:backend.
name: p3

scripts.dev:backend: node -e "require('child_process').spawn(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'mvnw.cmd' : './mvnw', ['spring-boot:run'], { cwd: 'src/public/backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).on('exit', c => process.exit(c ?? 0))"
